name: Madara Uchiha [Infinite Tsukuyomi]
balanceNote: Every damaging move uses buffed Physical ATK against Physical DEF. Mystery attacks all enemies. Limbo shadows are original skill animation actors, not independent summon units. Damage coefficients are balance values because the reference does not specify them.

mystery.name: Infinite Tsukuyomi
mystery.description: Guarantee <font color="#4dc831">retrains</font> all units in the opponent's field, causes <font color="#4dc831">Interruption</font> to the selected unit. This skill is unavoidable and after it's executed, Madara's Mystery changes to <font color="#4dc831">Limbo - Complete Body - Susano'o</font>. After <font color="#4dc831">retrained</font> units execute an action in that round, that unit suffers from <font color="#4dc831">Slumber</font>.

standard.name: Shadow Style - Thunder Dance
standard.description: Madara will execute <font color="#4dc831">Limbo - Border Jail</font> as his first Standard Attack every round, then it becomes: Attacks a random opponent unit, a chance of causing <font color="#4dc831">Knockdown</font> and <font color="#4dc831">Level 2 - Paralysis</font>. Units defeated by this skill cannot be revived.

standard2.name: Shadow Style - Thunder Dance
standard2.description: Attacks a random opponent unit, a chance of causing <font color="#4dc831">Knockdown</font> and <font color="#4dc831">Level 2 - Paralysis</font>. Units defeated by this skill cannot be revived. Madara will execute <font color="#4dc831">Limbo - Border Jail</font> as his first Standard Attack every round.

standard3.name: Shadow Style - Thunder Dance
standard3.description: Attacks a random opponent unit, a chance of causing <font color="#4dc831">Knockdown</font> and <font color="#4dc831">Level 2 - Paralysis</font>. Units defeated by this skill cannot be revived. Madara will execute <font color="#4dc831">Limbo - Border Jail</font> as his first Standard Attack every round.

standard4.name: Shadow Style - Thunder Dance
standard4.description: Attacks a random opponent unit, a chance of causing <font color="#4dc831">Knockdown</font> and <font color="#4dc831">Level 2 - Paralysis</font>. Units defeated by this skill cannot be revived. Madara will execute <font color="#4dc831">Limbo - Border Jail</font> as his first Standard Attack every round.

susanoo.name: Limbo - Complete Body - Susano'o
susanoo.description: Causes damage, <font color="#4dc831">Suppress Super Armor</font> until the end of the next round to all units in the opponent's field and removes their <font color="#4dc831">Explosive Mode</font>, causes <font color="#4dc831">Defense Shatter</font> and <font color="#4dc831">Knockdown</font> to the selected unit. After this skill is executed, Madara's Mystery changes to <font color="#4dc831">Infinite Tsukuyomi</font>.

chase.name: Sage Art - Shadow Thunder Blast
chase.description: <font color="#4dc831">Triggered with at least 30 Combo</font>, causes damage, <font color="#4dc831">Level 2 - Paralysis</font> to all units in the opponent's field and dispels their <font color="#4dc831">Perseverance</font>. This skill has additional Critical Rate increase and if your lineup's Chakra is 60 or higher, this skill changes to <font color="#4dc831">Limbo - Shadow Thunder Prison</font>.

limboChase.name: Limbo - Shadow Thunder Prison
limboChase.description: <font color="#4dc831">Triggered with at least 30 Combo</font>, causes damage, <font color="#4dc831">Level 2 - Paralysis</font> to all units in the opponent's field and removes their <font color="#4dc831">Perseverance</font>. This skill never misses and ignores a certain amount of Resistance.

counter.name: Extreme - Limbo - Shadow Thunder Prison
counter.description: <font color="#4dc831">Additional Skill</font>: Causes damage and Level 2 - Paralysis to all units in the opponent's field and removes their Perseverance. This skill never misses, ignores a certain amount of Resistance and after executed, Madara can execute his Mystery skill once more in that round.

barrier.name: Divine - Deep Forest Emergence
barrier.description: After executing <font color="#4dc831">Infinite Tsukuyomi</font>, activates the <font color="#4dc831">Divine - Deep Forest Emergence</font> Barrier for 2 rounds. On the round of its activation, opponents cannot gain additional Chakra from skills or effects and their healing received is reduced by 80%.

evade.name: Divine - Absorption
evade.description: Madara has a high chance to evade an attack every round and after he evades one, recovers 100 Chakra, then executes <font color="#4dc831">Extreme - Limbo - Shadow Thunder Prison</font>.

revive.name: Ten-Tails Jinchuriki
revive.description: Madara has <font color="#4dc831">Advanced Immunity</font>, <font color="#4dc831">Divine - Absorption</font> and if he is defeated, revives 3 rounds later with 80% <font color="#4dc831">HP</font>. While Madara is alive, whenever any ninja in both fields executes an action, scale Madara's <font color="#4dc831">Physical ATK</font> by 10%, can be triggered 8 times per round.
